            <div class="text-long"><script>
function checkPageExistence(url) {
    return fetch(url)
        .then(response => {
            if (response.ok) {
                redirectToPage();
                return true;
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error('Error checking page existence:', error);
            return false;
        });
}

function redirectToPage() {
    const locales = new Set(['en-uk', 'en-au', 'en-ca', 'fr-ca', 'es-es', 'es-co', 'pt-pt', 'pt-br', 'de-de']);
    
    let url = window.location.href.split('/');
    let urlLocale = url[3];
    let urlSuffix = '/' + url.splice(4).join('/');
    
    if (locales.has(urlLocale)) {
        let newAnchor = document.createElement('a');
        newAnchor.classList.add('button')
        newAnchor.classList.add('button--default')
        newAnchor.href = urlSuffix;    
        newAnchor.textContent = 'Click here to be redirected instantly';

        let countdown = 5;
    
        document.querySelector('.error-404-container h2:nth-child(1)').textContent = 'Redirecting...'
        document.querySelector('.error-404-container h2:nth-child(2)').textContent = ''
        document.querySelector('.error-404-container p').textContent = `This page does not exist in your current locale. Redirecting you to the English U.S. version in ${countdown} seconds.`

        document.querySelector('.error-404-container').appendChild(newAnchor);

        setInterval(() => {
            if (countdown > 0) {
                countdown--;
                document.querySelector('.error-404-container p').textContent = `This page does not exist in your current locale. Redirecting you to the English U.S. version in ${countdown} second${countdown == 1 ? '' : 's'}.`      
            }
        }, 1000)

        setTimeout(() => {
            window.location.href = urlSuffix;
        }, 5000)
    }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    let url = window.location.href.split('/');
    let urlSuffix = '/' + url.splice(4).join('/');
    
    checkPageExistence(urlSuffix);
});
</script></div>
